meta.title: CF 'Achievement-Children' — Charitable Foundation for Children
meta.description: We believe that every child deserves a happy and healthy childhood! The Achievement-Children Foundation strives for transparency and openness in its work.

hero.title: Every child deserves
hero.description: We help children with developmental disabilities undergo rehabilitation, receive necessary treatment and equipment. Together we can make the world kinder!

about.title: About the Foundation
about.description: The Achievement-Children Charitable Foundation helps children with developmental disabilities and their families. We organize rehabilitation courses, purchase necessary equipment, and hold events for children.
about.transparencyText: We regularly publish reports on our work and use of funds raised. 97% of all proceeds go directly to helping children.

help.title: How to Help
help.subtitle: EVERYONE CAN BE PART OF OUR PROJECTS
help.description: You can choose any convenient way to make voluntary donations. TOGETHER WE WILL MAKE THE WORLD KINDER!
